examples.chinese: 我要到郵局去寄信，也要買一些信封。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào yóujú qù jì xìn, yě yào mǎi yīxiē xìnfēng.
examples.english: I want to go to the post office to mail a letter, and also buy some envelopes.

items.wordHook: 信(letter) + 封(seal) → the sealed cover for a letter: envelope.

examples.chinese: 我去上課以前，一定會先在家吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù shàngkè yǐqián, yídìng huì xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: Before I go to class, I definitely will first eat breakfast at home.

examples.chinese: 一個小時以前，他還在這裡。
examples.pinyin: Yí ge xiǎoshí yǐqián, tā hái zài zhèlǐ.
examples.english: An hour ago, he was still here.

examples.chinese: 十分鐘以前我給他打了一個電話。
examples.pinyin: Shí fēnzhōng yǐqián wǒ gěi tā dǎ le yí ge diànhuà.
examples.english: Ten minutes ago, I gave him a phone call.

examples.chinese: 結婚以前，他覺得工作最重要，現在他覺得家人最重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn yǐqián, tā juéde gōngzuò zuì zhòngyào, xiànzài tā juéde jiārén zuì zhòngyào.
examples.english: Before getting married, he felt work was most important; now he feels family is most important.

examples.chinese: 以前妹妹很不喜歡穿裙子，現在她覺得穿裙子很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián mèimei hěn bù xǐhuan chuān qúnzi, xiànzài tā juéde chuān qúnzi hěn shūfu.
examples.english: In the past, my younger sister really didn't like wearing skirts; now she feels that wearing skirts is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 我每天上學以前，一定先在家吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shàngxué yǐqián, yídìng xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: Every day before I go to school, I always eat breakfast at home first.

examples.chinese: 來台灣學中文以前，我把一些舊書丟了。聽說你的車子丟了。是在哪裡丟的？
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén yǐqián, wǒ bǎ yīxiē jiù shū diū le. Tīngshuō nǐ de chēzi diū le. Shì zài nǎlǐ diū de?
examples.english: Before coming to Taiwan to study Chinese, I threw away some old books. I heard your car was lost. Where was it lost?

examples.chinese: 到國外生活以前，得先找租房子的資料。山本良介覺得在台灣生活的費用(生活費)不太高，日本的比較高。
examples.pinyin: Dào guówài shēnghuó yǐqián, děi xiān zhǎo zū fángzi de zīliào. Shānběn Liángjiè juéde zài Táiwān shēnghuó de fèiyòng (shēnghuófèi) bù tài gāo, Rìběn de bǐjiào gāo.
examples.english: Before going abroad to live, you must first find information about renting a place. Yamamoto Ryosuke feels that the cost of living in Taiwan is not very high; Japan's is higher.

examples.chinese: 他習慣睡覺以前聽一點兒音樂。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn shuìjiào yǐqián tīng yīdiǎnr yīnyuè.
examples.english: He is used to listening to a little music before sleeping.

examples.chinese: 我以前沒做過蛋糕，所以想試試。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián méi zuòguo dàngāo, suǒyǐ xiǎng shìshi.
examples.english: I have never made a cake before, so I want to try it.

examples.chinese: 以前沒什麼人喜歡露營，可是最近露營變成了一種流行的活動。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián méi shénme rén xǐhuān lùyíng, kěshì zuìjìn lùyíng biànchéngle yī zhǒng liúxíng de huódòng.
examples.english: Before, not many people liked camping, but recently camping has become a popular activity.

examples.chinese: 這裡的交通有很大的改變，比以前方便多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng yǒu hěn dà de gǎibiàn, bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn duō le.
examples.english: The transportation here has undergone a big change; it's much more convenient than before.

examples.chinese: 看病以前要先掛號，再照號碼進去看醫生。病人得先掛了號才可以看病。
examples.pinyin: Kànbìng yǐqián yào xiān guàhào, zài zhào hàomǎ jìnqù kàn yīshēng. Bìngrén děi xiān guà le hào cái kěyǐ kànbìng.
examples.english: Before seeing a doctor, you must first register, then go in according to your number to see the doctor. Patients must first register before they can see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwùshè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo hái méi chéngshú de shíhou shì lǜsè de, děng biàn chéng huángsè jiù shú le.
examples.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

examples.chinese: 這些筆電和平板都比以前的輕。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē bǐdiàn hé píngbǎn dōu bǐ yǐqián de qīng.
examples.english: These laptops and tablets are all lighter than previous ones.

examples.chinese: 這個週末以前，超過三千塊錢的東西都可以打九折，請把握機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò yǐqián, chāoguò sānqiān kuài qián de dōngxi dōu kěyǐ dǎ jiǔzhé, qǐng bǎwò jīhuì.
examples.english: Before this weekend, anything over 3,000 dollars is 10% off—please seize the opportunity.

examples.chinese: 我在車站遇到以前的同事，他現在是一家保險公司的經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chēzhàn yùdào yǐqián de tóngshì, tā xiànzài shì yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
examples.english: I ran into a former colleague at the station; he is now a manager at an insurance company.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de kōngqì biàn gānjìng le, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi yǒu jiéyùn yǐhòu, kāichē de rén bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.
examples.english: The air in this city has become cleaner, mainly because after the MRT was built, fewer people drive than before.

examples.chinese: 臺灣護照比以前好用得多，去許多國家旅行都不需要簽證了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hùzhào bǐ yǐqián hǎoyòng de duō, qù xǔduō guójiā lǚxíng dōu bù xūyào qiānzhèng le.
examples.english: A Taiwan passport is much more useful than before; when traveling to many countries, you don't need a visa anymore.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 去朋友家以前，一定要約好時間才去，這是做人的基本禮貌。孔子認為對人有禮貌、尊敬老師、孝順父母，是做人的基本。
examples.pinyin: Qù péngyǒu jiā yǐqián, yīdìng yào yuēhǎo shíjiān cái qù, zhè shì zuòrén de jīběn lǐmào. Kǒngzǐ rènwéi duì rén yǒu lǐmào, zūnjìng lǎoshī, xiàoshùn fùmǔ, shì zuòrén de jīběn.
examples.english: Before going to a friend's house, you must set a time before going; this is basic courtesy in dealing with people. Confucius believed that being polite to others, respecting teachers, and being filial to parents are the basics of being a person.

examples.chinese: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn jīntiān yùdào yǐqián de nǚpéngyǒu, gēn tā hē le kāfēi cái huí jiā, dàn bù gǎn gēn tàitai shuō shíhuà.
examples.english: Today Xiao Jian ran into his ex-girlfriend, and only went home after having coffee with her, but he didn't dare tell his wife the truth.

examples.chinese: 到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
examples.pinyin: Dào xīn gōngsī bàodào yǐqián, yīng xiān bǎ gèrén de tàidù jí guānniàn tiáozhěng hǎo.
examples.english: Before reporting for duty at a new company, you should first adjust your personal attitude and mindset well.

examples.chinese: 這份文件很急，請你下班以前傳真給對方公司。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn hěn jí, qǐng nǐ xiàbān yǐqián chuánzhēn gěi duìfāng gōngsī.
examples.english: This document is very urgent; please fax it to the other company before you get off work.

examples.chinese: 以前人們常用磁帶來存電腦的重要資料。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián rénmen cháng yòng cídài lái cún diànnǎo de zhòngyào zīliào.
examples.english: In the past, people often used magnetic tape to store important computer data.

examples.chinese: 做任何事以前要先想清楚，這麼做會有什麼後果。
examples.pinyin: Zuò rènhé shì yǐqián yào xiān xiǎng qīngchu, zhème zuò huì yǒu shénme hòuguǒ.
examples.english: Before doing anything, you must first think clearly what consequences doing so will have.

examples.chinese: 他以前化學成績常不及格，沒想到現在卻是有名的化學教授。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐqián huàxué chéngjī cháng bù jígé, méi xiǎngdào xiànzài què shì yǒumíng de huàxué jiàoshòu.
examples.english: He used to often fail chemistry, but unexpectedly now he is a famous chemistry professor.

examples.chinese: 以前我的小學老師總是親切地教導我們，讓我到現在還是很懷念她。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ de xiǎoxué lǎoshī zǒngshì qīnqiè de jiàodǎo wǒmen, ràng wǒ dào xiànzài háishì hěn huáiniàn tā.
examples.english: My elementary school teacher used to teach us kindly, which makes me still cherish her memory even now.

examples.chinese: 上臺報告以前要把資料準備好，以免到時候手忙腳亂的。
examples.pinyin: Shàngtái bàogào yǐqián yào bǎ zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, yǐmiǎn dào shíhou shǒumángjiǎoluàn de.
examples.english: Before going on stage to give a report, you need to prepare your materials well, so that you won't be in a rush and confused when the time comes.

examples.chinese: 在表演以前準備得越多，上舞臺就越有自信。
examples.pinyin: Zài biǎoyǎn yǐqián zhǔnbèi de yuè duō, shàng wǔtái jiù yuè yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: The more you prepare before a performance, the more confident you will be when you go on stage.

examples.chinese: 我的腰越來越胖，現在買的褲子尺寸比以前大了兩號。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yāo yuèláiyuè pàng, xiànzài mǎi de kùzi chǐcùn bǐ yǐqián dàle liǎng hào.
examples.english: My waist is getting fatter and fatter; the size of pants I buy now is two sizes larger than before.

examples.chinese: 以前學校規定女學生的髮型都要一樣，而且長度不能超過耳朵。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián xuéxiào guīdìng nǚ xuéshēng de fàxíng dōu yào yīyàng, érqiě chángdù bùnéng chāoguò ěrduo.
examples.english: In the past, the school required that female students' hairstyles all be the same, and the length could not exceed the ears.

examples.chinese: 這只箱子是以前奶奶留給我的，對我來說是很珍貴的禮物。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiāngzi shì yǐqián nǎinai liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō shì hěn zhēnguì de lǐwù.
examples.english: This suitcase is one that my grandmother left to me in the past; to me, it is a very precious gift.

examples.chinese: 這一屆的學生絕大部分都在畢業以前找到了工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yī jiè de xuéshēng jué dà bùfèn dōu zài bìyè yǐqián zhǎodào le gōngzuò.
examples.english: The vast majority of this year's graduating class found jobs before graduation.

items.wordHook: 以前 means 'in the past; before'. 前(front) shows the past lies in front of you in time.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友這次去英國玩了八天七夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou zhè cì qù Yīngguó wán le bā tiān qī yè.
examples.english: This time I went to England with a friend and played for eight days and seven nights.

examples.chinese: 上次我們吃牛肉麵，這次也吃牛肉麵，下次吃別的吧。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì wǒmen chī niúròumiàn, zhè cì yě chī niúròumiàn, xià cì chī bié de ba.
examples.english: Last time we ate beef noodles, this time we're also eating beef noodles; next time let's eat something else.

examples.chinese: 這次去荷蘭旅行的費用很高，因為車票很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qù Hélán lǚxíng de fèiyòng hěn gāo, yīnwèi chēpiào hěn guì.
examples.english: The cost of this trip to the Netherlands is very high because the train tickets are very expensive.

examples.chinese: 老師很滿意大家這次期中考的成績。這次期中考，大家都考得很好，老師覺得很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn mǎnyì dàjiā zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo de chéngjī. Zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo, dàjiā dōu kǎo de hěn hǎo, lǎoshī juéde hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The teacher is very satisfied with everyone's midterm exam results. On this midterm exam, everyone did very well, and the teacher feels very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 這次的旅行很順利，沒有什麼問題。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lǚxíng hěn shùnlì, méiyǒu shénme wèntí.
examples.english: This trip was very smooth; there were no problems.

examples.chinese: 暑假出國旅遊的人很多。這次的旅遊真有意思，我以後還想多去幾個地方玩。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià chūguó lǚyóu de rén hěn duō. Zhè cì de lǚyóu zhēn yǒu yìsi, wǒ yǐhòu hái xiǎng duō qù jǐ gè dìfang wán.
examples.english: Many people travel abroad during summer vacation. This trip is really interesting; in the future I want to go to more places to have fun.

examples.chinese: 這次考試的分數沒有我想的那麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de fēnshù méiyǒu wǒ xiǎng de nàme chà.
examples.english: The score on this exam is not as bad as I thought.

examples.chinese: 這次考試很難，可是大家的分數都不低，好奇怪！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì hěn nán, kěshì dàjiā de fēnshù dōu bù dī, hǎo qíguài!
examples.english: This exam was very hard, but everyone's scores are not low—how strange!

examples.chinese: 到東部的火車票很難訂，我訂了好幾次才成功。這次社區的中秋節活動辦得很成功，大家都玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Dào dōngbù de huǒchēpiào hěn nán dìng, wǒ dìng le hǎojǐ cì cái chénggōng. Zhè cì shèqū de zhōngqiūjié huódòng bàn de hěn chénggōng, dàjiā dōu wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Tickets for trains to the east are hard to book; I tried several times before succeeding. This time the community's Mid-Autumn Festival event was very successful, and everyone had a great time.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 這次期末的筆試不太難，大家都考得不錯。今天早上考筆試的時候，我寫得太慢了，所以沒寫完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò de bǐshì bù tài nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de bùcuò. Jīntiān zǎoshang kǎo bǐshì de shíhou, wǒ xiě de tài màn le, suǒyǐ méi xiě wán.
examples.english: This final written exam is not too hard; everyone did pretty well. This morning when I took the written exam, I wrote too slowly, so I didn't finish.

examples.chinese: 這次數學期末考的筆試很難，我有四題寫錯了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué qīmòkǎo de bǐshì hěn nán, wǒ yǒu sì tí xiě cuò le.
examples.english: This math final written exam was very hard; I got four questions wrong.

examples.chinese: 他這次到美國去出差，幫公司處理了不少問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè cì dào Měiguó qù chūchāi, bāng gōngsī chǔlǐ le bù shǎo wèntí.
examples.english: He went on a business trip to the US this time and handled quite a few problems for the company.

examples.chinese: 我這次考試的成績不太好，下次我會更加努力的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè cì kǎoshì de chéngjì bú tài hǎo, xià cì wǒ huì gèngjiā nǔlì de.
examples.english: My grades on this exam are not very good; next time I will work even more hard.

examples.chinese: 老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.
examples.english: This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke.

examples.chinese: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english: 1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 天哪！這次期末考真不容易呀，要是考不好被當了，怎麼辦哪？
examples.pinyin: Tiān na! Zhè cì qīmòkǎo zhēn bù róngyì ya, yàoshì kǎo bù hǎo bèi dāng le, zěnme bàn na?
examples.english: Oh my! This final exam is really not easy—if I don't do well and get flunked, what will I do?

examples.chinese: 這次颱風可能帶來大量雨水，地形較低的地區應該多注意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng kěnéng dàilái dàliàng yǔshuǐ, dìxíng jiào dī de dìqū yīnggāi duō zhùyì.
examples.english: This typhoon may bring a great amount of rain, so areas with lower terrain should pay more attention.

examples.chinese: 這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì cháhuì zhǔyào shì wèile zhāodài kèhù, tóngshí tòuguò zhège cháhuì lái fābiǎo gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This tea party is mainly to entertain clients, and at the same time, through this tea party, to launch the company's new products.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風雨大風又強，大街上不少店家都關店休息。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǔ dà fēng yòu qiáng, dàjiē shang bùshǎo diànjiā dōu guān diàn xiūxi.
examples.english: This typhoon brought heavy rain and strong winds; on the main street, many shops closed to rest.

examples.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
examples.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 這次傳染病的病毒很厲害，出門得戴著口罩，免得被傳染。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chuánrǎnbìng de bìngdú hěn lìhài, chūmén děi dàizhe kǒuzhào, miǎnde bèi chuánrǎn.
examples.english: The virus of this infectious disease is very severe; when going out, you must wear a mask so as not to get infected.

examples.chinese: 他贏了這次選舉只是運氣好罷了，其實他沒什麼能力。
examples.pinyin: Tā yíng le zhè cì xuǎnjǔ zhǐshì yùnqi hǎo bàle, qíshí tā méi shénme nénglì.
examples.english: He won this election only because he was lucky, that's all; actually, he doesn't have much ability.

examples.chinese: 這次活動大家都化裝參加，要是你碰見我大概認不出我是誰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng dàjiā dōu huàzhuāng cānjiā, yàoshi nǐ pèngjiàn wǒ dàgài rèn bù chū wǒ shì shéi.
examples.english: Everyone is attending this event in disguise; if you run into me, you probably won't recognize who I am.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shǒushù, dé le zhòngbìng de yīng'ér zhōngyú shùnlì de bǎo zhù le shēngmìng.
examples.english: After this surgery, the seriously ill baby finally had its life successfully protected.

examples.chinese: 這次申請獎學金，達到標準的學生總共不超過十人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn, dádào biāozhǔn de xuéshēng zǒnggòng bù chāoguò shí rén.
examples.english: For this scholarship application, the students who meet the standard total no more than ten people.

examples.chinese: 我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài zhè cì diànzǐ zhǎn gòng fābiǎo le jiǔ xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn, bìng xīyǐn bù shǎo guówài kèhù lái cānguān.
examples.english: Our company altogether launched nine new products at this electronics exhibition, and attracted many foreign clients to visit.

examples.chinese: 這次的說話比賽要求參加的學生說一個神奇的外國故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuōhuà bǐsài yāoqiú cānjiā de xuéshēng shuō yī gè shénqí de wàiguó gùshì.
examples.english: This speech contest requires participating students to tell a magical foreign story.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的效率真差，有人竟然沒看資料就來了，真是誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de xiàolǜ zhēn chà, yǒu rén jìngrán méi kàn zīliào jiù lái le, zhēn shì kuāzhāng.
examples.english: The efficiency of this meeting is really poor; someone surprisingly came without even looking at the materials—that's really outrageous.

examples.chinese: 這次文學比賽，我參加的項目是作文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì wénxué bǐsài, wǒ cānjiā de xiàngmù shì zuòwén.
examples.english: In this literature competition, the event I am participating in is essay writing.

examples.chinese: 這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì gōngsī zhǔbàn de, mùdì shì wèile zēngjiā tóngshì zhījiān de gǎnqíng.
examples.english: This event is organized by the company, and the purpose is to increase the bonds among colleagues.

examples.chinese: 你看，他們在跳舞，跳得真好看！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, tāmen zài tiàowǔ, tiào de zhēn hǎokàn!
examples.english: Look, they are dancing; they dance really beautifully!

examples.chinese: 他的舞跳得很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He dances very well.

examples.chinese: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

items.wordHook: a 口(gate) blocks a 止(stop) sign while a 兆(omen) leaps → 跳(hop).

examples.chinese: 要買什麼生日禮物送給女朋友，你想到了嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yào mǎi shénme shēngrì lǐwù sòng gěi nǚpéngyǒu, nǐ xiǎngdào le ma?
examples.english: Have you thought of what birthday gift to buy for your girlfriend?

examples.chinese: 沒想到利用春假出國旅行的人真不少！
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào lìyòng chūnjià chūguó lǚxíng de rén zhēn bùshǎo!
examples.english: I didn't expect that there are really quite a few people who take advantage of spring break to travel abroad!

examples.chinese: 我答應朋友去KTV幫他過生日，沒想到當天我太忙，忘了這件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dāyìng péngyou qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, méi xiǎngdào dāngtiān wǒ tài máng, wàng le zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: I promised my friend to go to KTV to celebrate his birthday, but I didn't expect that I would be too busy that day and forgot about this matter.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七○年 （qīlíng niándài，1970∼1979） 非常有名的功夫明星。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le. Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.
examples.english: I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now. Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 剛才我正想給英英打電話時，沒想到她就先打來了。
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ zhèng xiǎng gěi Yīngying dǎ diànhuà shí, méi xiǎngdào tā jiù xiān dǎ lái le.
examples.english: Just now, when I was right about to call Yingying, I didn't expect that she would call first.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 陳先生身體一向挺健康的，沒想到一個小感冒就讓他病了一個多月。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng shēntǐ yīxiàng tǐng jiànkāng de, méi xiǎngdào yī gè xiǎo gǎnmào jiù ràng tā bìng le yī gè duō yuè.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has always been quite healthy; I never expected that a small cold would make him fall ill for over a month.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.
examples.english: When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests.

examples.chinese: 如果你想到菲律賓旅行，還是帶著美金到當地換錢比較方便。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dào Fēilǜbīn lǚxíng, háishì dàizhe měijīn dào dāngdì huànqián bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
examples.english: If you want to travel to the Philippines, it's more convenient to bring US dollars and exchange money locally.

examples.chinese: 他以前化學成績常不及格，沒想到現在卻是有名的化學教授。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐqián huàxué chéngjī cháng bù jígé, méi xiǎngdào xiànzài què shì yǒumíng de huàxué jiàoshòu.
examples.english: He used to often fail chemistry, but unexpectedly now he is a famous chemistry professor.

examples.chinese: 他們班明天有一場籃球比賽，我想到現場替他們加油。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bān míngtiān yǒu yī chǎng lánqiú bǐsài, wǒ xiǎng dào xiànchǎng tì tāmen jiāyóu.
examples.english: Their class has a basketball game tomorrow; I want to go to the scene to cheer them on.

examples.chinese: 每次當我回憶起大學的社團生活，就會想到那一群知心好友。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒ huíyì qǐ dàxué de shètuán shēnghuó, jiù huì xiǎngdào nà yī qún zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Every time I recall my university club life, I think of that group of close friends.

examples.chinese: 以往在冬天才開的花，沒想到夏天就開了，大家都覺得很意外。
examples.pinyin: Yǐwǎng zài dōngtiān cái kāi de huā, méi xiǎngdào xiàtiān jiù kāi le, dàjiā dōu juéde hěn yìwài.
examples.english: Flowers that used to bloom only in winter unexpectedly bloomed in summer; everyone felt very surprised.

examples.chinese: 王先生上週向他女友求婚，沒想到才過了幾天就訂婚了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng shàng zhōu xiàng tā nǚyǒu qiúhūn, méi xiǎngdào cái guòle jǐ tiān jiù dìnghūn le.
examples.english: Mr. Wang proposed to his girlfriend last week; unexpectedly, just a few days later they got engaged.

examples.chinese: 這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bēibāo zài shèjì shàng méi shénme tèsè, zhǐshì yìnle mǒu wèi míngxīng suíshǒu huà de tú, méi xiǎngdào jiù yào mài shàng wàn yuán, shízài yǒudiǎnr kuāzhāng.
examples.english: This backpack has nothing distinctive in its design; it just has a picture casually drawn by some celebrity printed on it. I never expected it to sell for over ten thousand dollars—that's really a bit outrageous.

examples.chinese: 那家印尼餐廳常常客滿，你最好先打電話訂位。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìnní cāntīng chángcháng kèmǎn, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān dǎ diànhuà dìngwèi.
examples.english: That Indonesian restaurant is often full; you'd better call ahead to make a reservation.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡夏天到鄉下去住幾天，那裡比都市涼快多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan xiàtiān dào xiāngxia qù zhù jǐ tiān, nàlǐ bǐ dūshì liángkuai duō le.
examples.english: I like to go to the countryside to stay for a few days in summer; it is much more pleasantly cool there than in the city.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯在鄉下有一塊土地，可是地點很偏僻，想賣也賣不掉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo zài xiāngxià yǒu yī kuài tǔdì, kěshì dìdiǎn hěn piānpì, xiǎng mài yě mài bù diào.
examples.english: My uncle has a piece of land in the countryside, but the location is very remote; even if he wants to sell it, he can't sell it.

examples.chinese: 上個星期我去鄉下旅行，當地人非常好客。
examples.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ qù xiāngxià lǚxíng, dāngdìrén fēicháng hàokè.
examples.english: Last week I traveled to the countryside; the local people were very hospitable.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院每個月都到鄉下地區免費為老人門診。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn měi ge yuè dōu dào xiāngxià dìqū miǎnfèi wèi lǎorén ménzhěn.
examples.english: This hospital goes to rural areas every month to provide free outpatient service for the elderly.

examples.chinese: 學校安排我們到鄉下當「一日農民」，體驗農夫的辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào ānpái wǒmen dào xiāngxià dāng “yī rì nóngmín”, tǐyàn nóngfū de xīnkǔ.
examples.english: The school arranged for us to go to the countryside to be a 'farmer for a day' and experience the hardships of farmers.

examples.chinese: 我們週末常去鄉下走走，享受農村生活，黃昏時才回市區。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò cháng qù xiāngxià zǒuzou, xiǎngshòu nóngcūn shēnghuó, huánghūn shí cái huí shìqū.
examples.english: We often go to the countryside on weekends to enjoy rural life, and only return to the city at dusk.

examples.chinese: 公司的生產部門這個月規劃了員工旅遊，有三個不同地點讓大家選擇。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de shēngchǎn bùmén zhège yuè guīhuà le yuángōng lǚyóu, yǒu sān ge bùtóng dìdiǎn ràng dàjiā xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The company's production department planned an employee trip this month, with three different locations for everyone to choose from.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯在鄉下有一塊土地，可是地點很偏僻，想賣也賣不掉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo zài xiāngxià yǒu yī kuài tǔdì, kěshì dìdiǎn hěn piānpì, xiǎng mài yě mài bù diào.
examples.english: My uncle has a piece of land in the countryside, but the location is very remote; even if he wants to sell it, he can't sell it.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.
examples.english: The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

items.wordHook: Combining 滿(full) and 足(foot): 滿足 means satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小張不僅長得帥，穿著也很有品味，所以很多人都以為他是明星。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng bùjǐn zhǎng de shuài, chuānzhuó yě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi tā shì míngxīng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Zhāng is not only handsome but also dresses with great taste, so many people think he is a celebrity.

examples.chinese: A:喲，你今天怎麼穿得這麼帥？ B:下午要參加公司茶會，得穿得正式一些？ A:那下次跟我約會時，也要這麼穿呦！
examples.pinyin: A: Yō, nǐ jīntiān zěnme chuān de zhème shuài? B: Xiàwǔ yào cānjiā gōngsī cháhuì, děi chuān de zhèngshì yīxiē? A: Nà xià cì gēn wǒ yuēhuì shí, yě yào zhème chuān yo!
examples.english: A: Oh! How come you're dressed so handsome today? B: I have to attend the company tea party this afternoon, so I need to dress a bit formally? A: Then next time you go on a date with me, you should dress like this too!

examples.chinese: 有人覺得留鬍子比較帥，我倒是覺得留了鬍子看起來比較老。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén juéde liú húzi bǐjiào shuài, wǒ dàoshì juéde liú le húzi kàn qǐlái bǐjiào lǎo.
examples.english: Some people think that having a beard looks more handsome, but I actually think that having a beard makes you look older.

items.wordHook: Stationed upon a defensive 阜(mound), the commander straightens his silk 巾(cloth) looking dashing and 帥(handsome).

examples.chinese: 大地就像我們的母親一樣，一直保護著我們。
examples.pinyin: Dàdì jiù xiàng wǒmen de mǔqīn yíyàng, yìzhí bǎohùzhe wǒmen.
examples.english: The earth is like our mother, always protecting us.

examples.chinese: 那個外國人第一次來臺灣就碰上了大地震，讓他非常難忘。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó rén dì yī cì lái Táiwān jiù pèng shàng le dà dìzhèn, ràng tā fēicháng nánwàng.
examples.english: That foreigner encountered a major earthquake on his first visit to Taiwan, which made it very unforgettable for him.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái zài zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn zhōng shīqù le qīnrén, shízài tài kělián le.
examples.english: That child lost his family in this big earthquake; it's really too pitiful.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 難得今天有空，我們不如一口氣解決工作上所有的問題吧。
examples.pinyin: Nándé jīntiān yǒu kòng, wǒmen bùrú yìkǒuqì jiějué gōngzuò shàng suǒyǒu de wèntí ba.
examples.english: It's rare to have free time today; why don't we solve all the work problems in one go.

examples.chinese: 緊張的時候試著慢慢呼吸，吸一口氣，再慢慢呼出來，可以讓你輕鬆一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnzhāng de shíhou shìzhe mànman hūxī, xī yì kǒu qì, zài mànman hū chūlái, kěyǐ ràng nǐ qīngsōng yìdiǎnr.
examples.english: When you're nervous, try to breathe slowly: breathe in, then slowly breathe out—it can make you a little more relaxed.

examples.chinese: 團體活動中，不團結就失去了合作的意義。
examples.pinyin: Tuántǐ huódòng zhōng, bù tuánjié jiù shīqù le hézuò de yìyì.
examples.english: In group activities, if there is no unity, then the meaning of cooperation is lost.
